verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a dashboard to "track usage, costs, and performance across all providers," and users report seeing each request and its cost, plus charts, which go beyond OpenAI's daily totals. However, the evidence does not explicitly document token-count breakdowns, per-model slicing, or time-period filtering in the dashboards. Missing for 10: explicit per-model cost/token breakdown, time-range aggregation views, documented per-request token usage display.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards
